quality_baseline.quote: this is a quality threshold I feel genuinely comfortable getting behind for a large scale asset delivery. I suggest we expand each family categorically, growing our collections while we continue the restore path.
quality_baseline.scope_limit: Approval of the demonstrated catalogue asset-quality threshold, not the whole ship, room integration, gameplay, physics or native performance.

expansion_rules: Choose useful form/activity/mount/interface differences; no recolor-only count inflation
Integrated subparts and derived mirrors/closures/stock layouts/LODs are not separately counted designs
Use categories where purpose fits; zero does not demand an arbitrary asset
Retain distinct guest/public/staff/technical character and the full relevant reference set
Editable source, actual export review, independent checks and durable backup remain gates
Upcoming kits respond to documented district purpose, proportions, section and material character, rather than independent generic category filling
Real-room and neighborhood manual reviews resume when the original game is available

governing_canon.player_room: Shared with an existing crew member within the same 400; roommate story remains deferred
governing_canon.source_priority: Latest user decisions override older blueprint or design-document capacity/private-player-room labels. Catalogue components do not assign rooms, berths or persons.
